## 2026-11-01 S1830: R'-level G2/G3 actually proved

- [proof complete; both S1779 missing fields discharged] tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1830G2G3RPrimeActual.lean:
  S1830QuotientsMissing : S1779QuotientsMissing, S1830MonoMissing : S1779MonoMissing,
  S1830AlgPreGaloisMissing, S1830PreGaloisCategory : PreGaloisCategory S1779AlgR.
  G2 via the general fixed-point theorem FiniteEtaleFixedPointsGeneral.fixedPointSubalgebra_finiteEtale
  (arbitrary CommRing, no |G|-invertibility); G3 via epi→surjective, idempotent-kernel splitting,
  and the product-fan limit in the full subcategory.  R' is not a field; field-case arguments not used.
- [consumer] S1825's residual S1825AlgPreGaloisMissing is now inhabited; _S1830Consumer.lean
  derives PreGaloisCategory S1728Cover from any affine equivalence e : S1825AffineEquiv.
  Remaining S1825 inputs: affine equivalence (S1777/S1778) and geometric fiber functor
  (S1779FiberFunctorMissing), not G2/G3.
- [evidence] 26936 bytes, SHA256 4DD1...; EXIT=0, no warnings/sorryAx; olean 758360 bytes,
  SHA256 42A0...; axioms trio only.  Report: coord/reports/S1830-g2-g3-rprime-actual.md.
```
